one_liner: If you watch an ad after the game you get a voucher
author: aadi

change.adds: An opt-in banner on the home feed that lets a reader play one short sponsored game to hide the sponsored story cards in the feed and in articles for 30 minutes, plus a voucher for watching one more ad after the game.
change.offer_copy: Enjoying the news? Play a quick game and read with no sponsored stories in your feed or articles for the next 30 minutes. If you watch an ad after the game, you also get a voucher.

flow_steps.caption: The reader comes back to Top Stories after their third article today; the sponsored card sits below the first story.
A banner under the category pills offers 30 minutes with no sponsored stories for one quick game, and a voucher for one more ad after it.
The reader plays a short sponsored game and can close it at any time.
After the game, the reader can watch one more ad to get a voucher.
Once the play is confirmed, the feed reloads without the sponsored card and a small note shows 30 minutes left.
